title: Looking Up
alt: A black-and-white woodpecker clinging to a tree trunk on the right, head tilted up, framed by dark branches and soft green leaves.

title: Among the Berries
alt: The same woodpecker seen from behind on a branch, head turned to the left, among twigs hung with small dark berries against a pale sky.

title: Last Light
alt: A woodpecker on a dark, leaning trunk in dim evening light, almost lost among bare crossing branches.

title: In the Thicket
alt: A black-and-white woodpecker in profile on a slim trunk, looking up and to the left, with dark branches, hanging berries and soft leaves crowding the frame against a pale sky.

title: Rose
alt: A loose acrylic painting of a single pink-red rose with one leaf on a dark stem, against a swirling teal and deep blue sky with lilac clouds, a green hill at the bottom right.

title: Streetlight in fog
alt: A streetlight glowing through thick night fog with a soft rainbow ring around it, a line of smaller lights fading away below it and the dark shape of a tree on the right.

title: Figure in ink
detail: ink drawing, photographed on iPhone 15 Pro
alt: A loose black ink drawing of a figure lying on its side with closed eyes and wild, flowing hair, one arm reaching across the page, drawn in quick hatched strokes on cream paper.

title: Jasmine tea
alt: Looking down into a white bowl of steeped green tea leaves with a few white jasmine buds and small bubbles, a shaft of sunlight across the leaves.

title: Red wings
detail: snow sculpture by the Hôtel de Glace sculptors, Québec; iPhone 15 Pro, f/1.78, 1/105 s, ISO 200
alt: A carved snow relief of a young winged figure with curly hair looking upward, arms spread along huge feathered wings, all lit deep red.
